compressWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
compressWizard.recompressImagesDesc: Re-encode embedded images as JPEG, optionally capped to a paper size. The biggest source of savings for image-heavy PDFs.
compressWizard.subsetFontsDesc: Strip unused glyphs from embedded fonts.
compressWizard.deduplicateObjectsDesc: Merge identical resources into a single copy.
compressWizard.sanitizeStreamsDesc: Remove redundant operators from page content.
compressWizard.previewHint: Click Update preview to see how a page will look after compression.
compressWizard.resultPlaceholder: Click Calculate savings to compress this PDF and see the size difference.
compressWizard.outdated: Settings have changed since this was calculated — recalculate to update.
compressWizard.noSavingsHint: This PDF is already well-compressed. Try lowering image quality for more savings.
compressWizard.overlayDescription: Compression can take a while for large or image-heavy PDFs. Hang tight.

compressWizard.resizeHint: Caps image dimensions so they fit the chosen paper at the chosen DPI. Use 72 for on-screen viewing, 150 for general print, 300 for photo-quality print.

htmlToPdfWizard.title: HTML to PDF
htmlToPdfWizard.metaDescription: Convert HTML files, pasted markup, or a web page URL to a PDF with selectable text and clickable links. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlPrivacyNote: Your browser fetches the page directly from the site — HermitPDF has no servers and never sees the address. Only sites that permit cross-site browser access (CORS) can be fetched this way.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid web address.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorInsecure: Insecure http:// pages can't be fetched from an https app. Try the https:// version of the address.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorCors: {host} doesn't allow browsers on other sites to fetch its pages — a security policy called CORS, set by that site. HermitPDF can't bypass it without routing the page through a server, which it will never do.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorCorsTip: Tip: open the page in a new tab, save it as an HTML file (Ctrl/Cmd+S), and upload that file here instead.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorUnreachable: Couldn't reach {host}. Check the address and your connection.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorHttp: The site responded with an error (HTTP {status}).
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorNotHtml: That address returned {type}, not a web page.
htmlToPdfWizard.urlErrorOversized: The page is too large to convert (max 25 MB).
htmlToPdfWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
htmlToPdfWizard.keepLinksDesc: Preserve web links and in-page anchors as clickable PDF links.
htmlToPdfWizard.localNote: Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Remote images, stylesheets, and scripts are never fetched or executed — embedded (data:) images work. Complex modern CSS may render simplified; the preview shows exactly what you will get.
htmlToPdfWizard.overlayDescription: Laying out the HTML — this may take a moment for large documents.
htmlToPdfWizard.oversizedFile: File too large to convert (max 25 MB): {file}
htmlToPdfWizard.onlyOneFile: Only one file can be converted at a time. Using the first HTML file.
htmlToPdfWizard.conversionFailed: Conversion failed. The HTML may be malformed or too complex.
